build_web_graph_dataset: build a WebGraph dataset builder with tfds for sparse or dense web link graph data
create_web_graph_config: create a WebGraphConfig builder config specifying subfolder and num_shards for a dataset version
run_web_graph_splits: run the WebGraph dataset builder to generate train, train_t, and test splits from TFRecord shards
review_web_graph_generate_examples: review the _generate_examples method that processes TFRecord files into row_tag, col_tag, gt_tag examples
summarize_web_graph_info: summarize the _info method that returns dataset metadata with features and citation
